d: Room in the palace, illuminated by various lamps. The Provider Paolo Erisso sits silent at a table. Other Captains sit around him. Calbo and Condulmiero close the circle, sitting together.
Cabinet by Anna Erisso; a lamp illuminates him. Anna, then Erisso and Calbo.

The square of the city of Negroponte. Straight to the viewer a temple: at the bottom a wide way, which will be arranged obliquely in such a way that the principle of the same hides to the eye of the spectator on his left. The music from this moment, until Erixus arrives on the scene, must always indicate the distant tumult of the battle. From time to time they hear the shots of the cannon and the discharges of muskets. Some women run to the amazing, uncertain and terrified, wandering around the scene.

Day. A host of Muslim Knights arrives from the viewer's starboard side: it stops rather to recognize which way it should pick to chase the fugitives. Then the Commander's signal will start along the big road leading at the bottom of the theater. Begin to listen from a distance to the sound of the Turkish gangs. After a moment the Cavalleria line will return, turning left of the viewer, on the trail of Erix. There is a good number of Turkish soldiers, in bulk and armed with faces.
Omar, followed by his soldiers, leads in chains Calbo and Erissus, who present themselves with dignified restraint.
The Guards surround Erixus and Calbo and drag them. Anna rushes from the temple, up their steps, giving a cry of sorrow. The other Women sieguano.

A rich pavilion of Muhammad in which all the objects of Eastern luxury are seen gathered together. Anna sitting on a sofa, in the greatest pain and covering her face with her hands. A host of Muslim Donzelle beautifully dressed surround her, divided into various groups: some are kneeling before her, offering her rich gifts of all sorts: others further back support of the vases of perfumes, others will finally sing the following choir.

Large underground of the temple, all scattered with tombs, among which will be notable to the viewer that of the wife of Paolo Erisso. Erisso and Calbo. At the rise of the canvas Erisso and Calbo will be seen on the last steps of the staircase, and they will be slowly added.
Anna, dismayed and silent, sits on her mother's grave. Short silence.

Muhammad, followed by Selimo and his other Captains, comes rushing into the basement with the fury painted on his face. He advances and remains immobile for a little while, keeping his eyes fixed on Anna. She does not dare to look at him. Universal silence.
